post.description: Applies the message to the working draft and streams the edited graph as text/event-stream: `event: meta` ({name}), then `event: node`/`event: edge` as each completes, ending in `event: result` ({name, graph}) or `event: error` ({status, message, code?}). 409 if the session is closed; 402 if the workspace is over its monthly budget.

200.description: SSE stream ending in a `result` or `error` frame.

403.description: Authenticated but not permitted for this workspace.

409.description: The resource is in a state that conflicts with the request.

403.description: Authenticated but not permitted for this workspace.

info.title: naary API
info.description: Control plane for durable, human-in-the-loop AI-agent + webhook workflows. Authenticate every request with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — an `nry_` API token (mint one in the app, or `POST /tokens`) or a Firebase ID token.

bearer.description: An `nry_…` API token or a Firebase ID token.

subject.description: The authenticated subject (user id / email), if any.

message.description: Human-readable message — a string, or an array of field errors for validation failures.

error.description: Error class name (present on framework exceptions).

flags.description: Flag key → enabled, evaluated server-side for THIS tenant only. Never exposes the provider key.

tokenId.description: ApiToken id attached to the group.

environmentId.description: null = every environment; otherwise the one env this grant applies to.

tagIds.description: Tag ids carried by this 'selected' grant (effective keys = workflowKeys ∪ keys tagged with any of these). Empty for scope 'all'.

environmentId.description: Environment this grant applies to (an env id of this workspace). null/absent = every environment (RBAC-GROUPS.md §8.5).

scope.description: 'all' = every workflow in the workspace; 'selected' = exactly the listed workflowKeys.

canShare.description: share = promote to another environment (§8.2), nothing more.

canCreate.description: Create NEW workflows (its own verb, §8.3). Valid only with scope 'all' — 400 otherwise.

workflowKeys.description: Workflow keys for scope 'selected' (replace-set on update). Ignored for scope 'all'.

tagIds.description: Tag ids for scope 'selected' (replace-set on update; must belong to the workspace). Effective keys = workflowKeys ∪ every key carrying ANY of these tags (§9 tag-scoped grants). NOTE: the workspace's first TagGrant makes tags access-bearing — tag edits then require the Promote permission. Ignored for scope 'all'.

all.description: true = every workflow (keys is then empty).

restricted.description: false = full access (owner/admin, unrestricted token, or a workspace with no grants).

isDefault.description: The default env — holds pre-environments data; can't be deleted.

slug.description: Stable header/URL-safe slug (lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, ≤32 chars).

environmentId.description: Canonical Environment.id the actor had selected when acting; null when none. The actor's env context, not a resource FK.

tags.description: Organizational tags (tenant-wide per workflowKey, identical in every environment).

prompt.example: When a webhook arrives, have an agent summarize it, wait for my approval, then email the summary.
prompt.description: Plain-English description of the workflow to build.

provider.description: Provider to generate with. Omitted ⇒ the tenant's first configured+valid model provider, falling back to the Claude Code credential (subscription-billed, via the headless CLI).

workflow.description: The n8n workflow export: `{ name, nodes: [...], connections: {...} }`. Credentials in it are IGNORED — the response reports which connection types to create instead.

nodeId.description: Our node id in the draft graph. Null when the node is intentionally NOT a graph node (`skipped`: an n8n sticky note, a disabled node, or an AI sub-node).

status.description: `imported` = faithful. `approximated` = runs, but something was reshaped. `unmapped` = no equivalent, so it became a noOp placeholder carrying its original n8n config under `__n8n`. `skipped` = deliberately not a graph node.

notes.description: What was lost or is left to do. Always non-empty unless status is `imported`.

usedBy.description: n8n node names that used it.

suggestedConnectionType.description: The connection type to create here, or null when we have no equivalent.

reason.example: n8n's $now is a DateTime object; use a dateTime node instead

graph.description: The draft graph { nodes, edges, startNodeId }. Not saved.

nodes.description: One entry per node in the export — nothing is dropped silently.

warnings.description: Whole-workflow warnings to read BEFORE saving (e.g. a schedule trigger goes live on save).

savedBy.description: Who saved this version (email / 'api-token'); null for promoted or pre-feature rows (#488).

saveMessage.example: Add retry to the HTTP node
saveMessage.description: Optional commit note recorded on save; null when none (#488).

workflowKey.description: Stable key the workflow is stored + run under.

message.example: Add retry to the HTTP node
message.description: Optional commit note recorded on this version (#488, shown in version history).

toEnv.description: Target environment id or slug to promote INTO.

fromVersion.description: Source version to promote (default: the source env's latest version).

toVersion.description: Version in the target env (a new version, or an existing one if the graph was identical).

nextRunAt.description: Next fire time from Temporal, or null if unknown/paused.

workflowKey.description: The workflow to run on the schedule.

paused.description: true to pause the schedule, false to resume.

active.description: true to activate the workflow's triggers, false to deactivate.

id.description: Channel id — the handle for update/delete/test.

type.description: Channel type — determines the delivery format (Slack blocks / Teams card / SMTP email).

label.description: User-facing name distinguishing same-type channels. Null = unnamed.

enabled.description: Whether this channel sends. Off = skipped even with a URL set.

webhookUrl.description: Outbound webhook URL for this channel. Null = none set.

emailConnectionId.description: Email channels: id of the smtp connection this channel sends through. Null for webhook channels / unconfigured.

emailTo.description: Email channels: recipient addresses. Empty for webhook channels.

onApprovalPending.description: Notify this channel when a run pauses for approval.

onRunFailed.description: Notify this channel when a run fails.

onBudgetThreshold.description: Notify this channel when monthly spend crosses the budget's alert threshold (once per calendar month). Default off.

onPromotion.description: Notify this channel when a workflow is promoted into this environment. Default off.

input.description: Initial input available to the workflow context.

workflowKey.description: Which stored graph to run (its workflowKey). Defaults to 'default'.

debug.description: Verbose per-run logging: the worker logs this run's activities at DEBUG level (others stay at LOG_LEVEL). Filter the logs by the returned workflowId. Off by default.

workflowId.description: Temporal workflowId of the started run.

status.description: App status or a Temporal close reason (failed | timed_out | terminated | canceled | unknown).

finishedAt.description: When the run reached a terminal status (worker-stamped); null for in-flight runs and runs predating the stamp.

durationMs.description: finishedAt − createdAt in ms; null whenever finishedAt is null (never derived from now).

failureKind.description: Compact failure classification on terminal failures (timeout | upstream_5xx | rate_limit | budget | rejected | error); null → fall back to the status.

graphVersion.description: The workflow graph version this run snapshotted at start; null for pre-migration rows.

instructions.example: Review the summary before it is emailed.

pausedAt.description: When the gate paused (worker clock at pause time).

slaHours.description: The gate's display-only SLA in hours.

dueAt.description: pausedAt + slaHours (server-derived); null unless both exist.

contextFields.description: Structured context card — expressions resolved at pause time (never secrets).

ids.description: workflowIds of the paused runs to decide together.

approved.description: true to approve every listed run, false to reject every one.

comment.description: Reviewer note recorded with every decision in the batch.

error.example: Execution is not awaiting approval (already completed, rejected, or failed).
error.description: Why this run wasn't decided (present only when ok is false).

ids.description: workflowIds of the runs to archive/restore together.

archived.description: true archives every listed run, false restores every one.

ids.description: workflowIds of the running/paused runs to cancel together.

approved.description: true to approve, false to reject the paused run.

comment.description: Reviewer note recorded with the decision.

sent.description: How many notification channels the reminder was delivered to.

graphVersion.description: A specific saved version of this run's workflow to re-run at (newer or older). Omit to re-run against the latest.

path.description: Relative path an external system POSTs to resume the run. The token is the credential.

graph.description: The version-pinned GraphDef the run walked (nodes, edges, startNodeId).

version.description: The workflow graph version this run executed; null for pre-migration runs.

workflowKey.description: The run's workflowKey (drives the re-run-at-version picker); null for very old runs.

status.description: App status or a Temporal close reason (failed | timed_out | terminated | canceled | unknown).

executedNodeIds.description: Node ids known to have run — populated for a failed run whose ctx came back empty (#525); empty when the ctx itself carries the outputs.

nodeTimes.description: Per-node timing map (Slice 2): { [nodeId]: { s, f, n?, totalMs? } } — epoch-ms start/finish stamped with deterministic workflow time; n/totalMs aggregate repeated passes (loops). Null when the run predates the feature or its ctx is unavailable.

spentUsd.description: Live spend-so-far of this run in USD (the interpreter's metered cost accumulator). Null when unavailable (pre-feature worker or Temporal-level failure).

perExecutionCapUsd.description: The per-run budget cap this run enforces (snapshotted at start, refreshed after a budget-pause resume). Null when no cap is configured or the run is closed.

kind.description: Coarse kind for the UI icon/colour.

awaiting.description: Whether the run is still awaiting a decision.

instructions.example: Review the summary before it is emailed.

workspaceName.description: Workspace display name — the page's trust line (on behalf of …). Null when unset.

contextFields.description: Structured context card — expressions resolved at pause time (never secrets).

expiresAt.description: When this signed link expires (its `exp` claim). Null for legacy links minted without one.

exp.description: The link's `exp` claim (unix seconds), when the link carried one. Signed into the token — required to verify an expiring link.

isValid.description: Whether the stored key last validated successfully.

provider.description: Provider the key belongs to (e.g. anthropic, openai, google).

apiKey.description: The provider API key. Validated, encrypted at rest, never echoed back.

idpEntityId.description: The IdP's SAML entity id — the assertion <Issuer>. Unique across the instance: it is how an unauthenticated ACS POST maps to this workspace.

idpCertPem.description: The IdP's SIGNING CERTIFICATE (PEM, or the bare base64 from its metadata <X509Certificate>). Public key material only.

allowedEmailDomains.description: Email domains this IdP may assert. REQUIRED and non-empty — an empty list would let this IdP assert any address, which is exactly the cross-tenant linking hole.

defaultRole.description: Role granted when auto-provisioning. Never read from the assertion.

autoProvision.description: Create a Membership on first login (JIT). Default true.

environmentId.description: Environment id; null for spend recorded before env tagging.

workflowKey.description: Workflow key; null for runs with no key (pre-migration).

nodeType.description: Node type that spent this (stamped on the ledger row); null for pre-feature rows.

avgDurationMs.description: Average measured call duration in ms over rows that carry one; null when none do.

workflowKey.description: Workflow key; null for runs with no key (pre-migration).

avgDurationMs.description: Average run duration in ms over runs with a worker-stamped finishedAt; null when none have one.

kind.description: failureKind when recorded, else the close status (pre-feature fallback).

hasSecret.description: Whether a secret key is stored (write-only — the value is never returned).

allowedHostnames.description: Allowed solved-Turnstile hostnames (empty ⇒ any). A submission's hostname must match.

workflowId.description: The workflow (workflowKey) this chat starts per message.

chatPath.description: Public path to host the chat (host is deployment-specific).

serverUrl.description: https URL for MCP/HTTP connections, or a non-secret display host for DB connections (the DSN rides in `token`).

token.description: Secret credential (PAT / api_token / connection string). Stored encrypted, never returned.

serverUrl.description: https URL for MCP/HTTP connections, or a non-secret display host for DB connections.

usedByNodeCount.description: How many nodes across the tenant's latest graphs in this env reference this connection (#471). 0 = unreferenced (safe to delete).

credentialLast4.description: Last 4 characters of the stored raw bearer token (#471, pat/api_token modes) — a 'which key is this?' hint, like a card's last-4; NEVER the full token. null for connection-string (DB/SMTP) secrets, oauth/github_app (which store a JSON grant, not a token), connections with no stored token yet, or secrets shorter than 4 chars.

provider.description: Catalog provider to test this connection against (the same `provider` an `integration` node would use).

ok.description: True only when the provider answered 2xx. `unknown` is not ok.

status.description: `ok` = the provider accepted the credential. `failed` = it was rejected or unreachable. `unknown` = no safe read-only call exists for this provider, so nothing was called.

httpStatus.description: The provider's HTTP status, or null when no call was made.

checkedAction.description: The `provider.action` that was called — always a catalog action with `write: false` and no required fields. Null when nothing safe existed.

connectionStatus.description: The connection's status after the test. Null when the test learned nothing about the token (`unknown`) and therefore left the status untouched.

source.description: 'curated' means the upstream registry was unavailable and this is the degraded (in-repo) list.
